items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: he and I used to work at the Indiana Avenue Theater together

ctx.x: Did you meet some boogie players? You know, I'm very interested in...

Yes. He's very fun of mine. Albert's a great fun of mine. I like his style very much. Albert Avenue was a great fun of mine. What do you mean? Uh... He's in fact, uh, he... he and I used to work at the Indiana Avenue Theater together, see, and he... Like, he'd take two weeks, three weeks. In which... Indiana Avenue. Indiana Avenue. Well, he'd play a few weeks and then I'd go in with my band. It was all donated like that. Did he have a band? Yeah. Yeah. Let me get ready. Just a minute. Oh, sure. He's a kid. Oh!…
Now that's what my album piano player is. Yes. I can understand you. He plays... you still can play Marvel.
